chain.desc: state as generateState() reads it from chain (slot0.protocolFee+lpFee, all ticks); _swap() with the vector price limit; lpFeeOverride=0 as production

chainOverride.desc: same as chain, but the vector lpFeeOverride passed into _swap() (capability check; production never passes it)

query.desc: production entrypoint queryOutputs() (SELL for exact-in, BUY for exact-out), only on non-reverting vectors that filled fully (price limit not binding)

eventBuilt.desc: state built purely from events: Initialize -> ModifyLiquidity* -> ProtocolFeeUpdated (handlers as in uniswap-v4-pool.ts); _swap() with vector params
